title: TrueBlue to Participate in Upcoming September Conferences
summary: TACOMA, Wash., September 02, 2026--TrueBlue (NYSE: TBI), a leading provider of specialized workforce solutions, today announced that President and CEO Taryn Owen and CFO Carl Schweihs will participate in both the Northcoast Virtual Conference on Wednesday, September 9th, 2026, and the William Blair Human Capital Services Conference on Tuesday, September 22, 2026.
